ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.5 Resumable JobGiver
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.9.5 Resumable JobGiver for RimWorld 1.5. Keeps the consolidated stable core, ReachProfile V0.4.18, V0.9.4 lightweight JobGiver tail buckets and acceleration-only GenClosest cold sleep. Repeatedly slow exact JobGiver_Work thing scanners may spread original main-thread validator work across bounded slices; when a slice suspends, lower-priority WorkGivers are not allowed to pass it in that package. Final Reachability, validator and Job decisions remain live. The zero-yield V0.9.4 HaulMerge cheap-negative experiment is retired and physically excluded. V25 memo, V19-V21 ReachProfile experiments, resident hot-path profilers, PathSnapshot and WorkPrefilter remain excluded.
